730-880-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
730-880-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

232-678-4247.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1349-6798-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-6798-6854.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 6.
Repeat.

618-5147-6132.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-3755-6633-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1895-4399-4518-4716.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4518-4716.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

460-539-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Doc Samson.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2034-5088-5148-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three basic lands.
2034-5088-5148-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2034-5088-5148-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping basic lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Early Harvest with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Early Harvest from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Early Harvest.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1298-1618-2440-3992.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Ovika triggers, creating a number of creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token for each trigger.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.

1824-2530-2906-7359.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-2906-7359.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
1824-2530-2906-7359.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Tablet of the Guilds triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

4050-5010-7028-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from your library.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat from step 2

1563-3899-4365-6791.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

236-539-3899-4365-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2267-5220-6441-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2267-5220-6441-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

4195-4211-4574-6900.description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Resolve the Tormod's Crypt ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3649-6657.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
3649-6657.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {4} and tapping it, copying Etrata's trigger twice.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.
3649-6657.notes: If the opponent already has cards exiled with hit counters, you can reduce Gogo's cost or eliminate Gogo entirely.

789-2034-2399--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
789-2034-2399--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing that creature, adding {C}{C}
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Ooze, adding {C}{C}.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
789-2034-2399--129.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

813-3617-4598.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Walk and Essence Flux.
813-3617-4598.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

851-2793-3017-3743-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
851-2793-3017-3743-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

880-4826-5671.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4826-5671.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

338-1270-3490-3910-5296.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Workhorse.
338-1270-3490-3910-5296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
338-1270-3490-3910-5296.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create three 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

1589-3182-4050-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three legendary creatures.
1589-3182-4050-4772.description:
Activate Sokenzan's second ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
Turntimber Sower triggers, creating two 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Resolve the Sokenzan ability, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two creatures, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G} and sacrificing three creatures, returning Sokenzan from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2367-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {1}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create a 1/1 Servo creature token.
Repeat.

2051-4011-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
2051-4011-4377-4423.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, taking an extra turn after this one.
On your next draw step, use Life from the Loam's dredge ability by milling three cards, returning it from your graveyard to your hand instead of drawing.
In your main phase, cast Life From the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning three Islands from your graveyard to your hand.
Play three Islands.
Repeat each turn until you have too few cards left in library to pay Life from the Loam's dredge cost.
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two additional Islands, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Mystic Sanctuary and two additional Island cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Play two Islands and Mystic Sanctuary.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself, putting Life from the Loam from your graveyard on top of your library.
Repeat each turn.

1636-2034-2545-3524-4096.description:
Sacrifice Gleaming Barrier to Ashnod's Altar, generating {C}{C} and {W} from the treasure.
Activate Golbin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Idol of Endurance and returning Gleaming Barrier from the graveyard to the battlefield and triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping Goblin Welder and leaving {2}{W} floating.
Activate Golbin Welder, sacrificing Gleaming Barrier and returning Idol of Endurance to play, exiling Gleaming Barrier to Idol of Endurance's trigger and adding {W} through the treasure, leaving {2}{W}{W} floating.
Activate Idol of Endurance for {1}{W} and cast Gleaming Barrier without paying its mana cost, triggering Intruder Alarm and untapping Goblin Welder, leaving {1}{W} floating.
Repeat for infinite colored and colorless mana.

1646-2034-4831.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Cacophodon indestructible.
1646-2034-4831.description:
Give Cacophodon indestructible by any method.
Activate Acorn Catapult by paying {1} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Cacophodon and creating a 1/1 Squirrel token.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Acorn Catapult.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
